title: Visible handwashing flow for a new-video check

reference.title: Visible handwashing flow for a new-video check
reference.scope: Predeclared visible-action reference for transfer checking, not a hygiene-quality assessment. Unseen actions remain unknown. No expected timestamps are supplied.

steps.label: Wet hands with water
steps.criterion: Running or poured water visibly contacts hands before a visible soap-lather episode. A faucet or sink alone is insufficient.

steps.label: Apply soap to hands
steps.criterion: Hands visibly receive soap from a dispenser, bottle, or bar. Lather alone does not prove application.

steps.label: Rub hands with soap lather
steps.criterion: Hands rub together with visible soap foam; rubbing without visible foam is uncertain.

steps.label: Rinse hands with water
steps.criterion: After visible lather rubbing, water visibly contacts the hands; rubbing beside a faucet is insufficient.

steps.label: Dry hands
steps.criterion: A towel or paper visibly contacts and wipes the hands, or hands are held in a visibly operating air dryer. Holding a towel nearby is insufficient.
